name: B10-0577/2025 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the mass kidnapping of schoolchildren and teachers in Nigeria, including about 303 children and 12 teachers taken from St Mary's Catholic School in Papiri on 21 November 2025. It condemns the abductions, demands the release of everyone held, and asks Nigerian authorities to investigate, protect schools and bring those responsible to justice.

- The Parliament calls for the immediate release of all kidnapped schoolchildren and teachers.
- It urges Nigeria to investigate the abductions, protect schools and use early warning systems.
- It asks the international community to give more humanitarian aid to Nigeria.
